name: Contact Storage Disable Mail
description: Lets you disable email notifications on a per-contact-form basis.
project_description:
This module provides administrators with the ability to disable email notifications on a per-contact form basis.

 With this module, site administrators can choose which contact forms should send an email notification and which ones shouldn't. This is really useful in combination with the Contact Storage module.

 Once installed, simply go to the configuration, edit the contact form type, and check the Disable Mail Send option. It's that simple!

 Requirements 
 
 Contact Storage .
